related_distinct_tracks: UR1 neural PR12 and target-order PR13

sole_experimental_factor: For every (high v in 6..14, low s in 0..3), allocate orientation to high-first when (v-6+s) is even, otherwise high-second, instead of all pairs high-first or all pairs high-second. Equal 36 supplemental r2 question count, equal per-v and per-s exposures, equal model, initial weights, permutations, optimizer and updates; this is a curriculum allocation-policy comparison, not a pure input-position-only intervention.
a_priori_question: Can exposure to every high token in BOTH answer positions, holding the 36-question supplemental count and per-token frequencies fixed, permit correct transfer to the previously untrained reverse orientation and to low-partner s4/s5?

profile.name: SLE-AE1-n5-v1
profile.question: 01 + 010 + (three info bits for r + terminal 0) + 4*(five info bits ID+terminal 0) + END 111100
profile.answer: first r complete 6-bit payload words + separate external STOP S

split.base: All 36 (a,b) 0..5 pairs; (a+b)%6 == 0 is validation (6 pairs), ==1 is test (6 pairs), remaining 24 pairs train. Two r versions per pair. c=d=0.
split.supplement_train: 36 r2 pairs v6..14,s0..3, exactly one of (v,s) and (s,v), selected by parity (v-6+s)%2; 18 first and 18 second; every v occurs 2x in each role and every low s remains at 9 total exposures.
split.counterfactual_untrained_orientation: 36 r2 inverse-orientation pairs for the same 36 (v,s) choices; no train duplicates; diagnostic, not blind.
split.heldout_val: s=4, v6..14, high in first or second role, 18 r2 pairs; never trained; results already seen as class in parent PR36, not novel blind.
split.heldout_test: s=5, v6..14, high in first or second role, 18 r2 pairs; never trained; results already seen as class in parent PR36, not novel blind.
split.nuisance: third/fourth payload words c=d=0 in all conditions

model_training.start_state: fresh model identical torch.manual_seed(seed) and SHA256 to previous PR36 seed counterpart, not checkpoint warm-start
model_training.optimizer: Adam lr=0.003; batch=64; grad_clip_norm=1; no early-stop
model_training.epoch_shuffling: numpy.default_rng(seed+87000+epoch).permutation(948), same as original PR36 for each seed

preregistered_evaluation.primary: For each seed, complete free-generated r2+STOP accuracy on 36 reverse-orientation cases and 18+18 heldout s4/s5 (report both roles separately), versus old PR36 per-seed exclusive-arm controls; no test-based selection.
preregistered_evaluation.secondary: 36 in-orientation train examples, base train/val/test, first/second six-bit word and terminal-zero checks, external STOP and cap failures, explicit full raw Q/expected/actual for every case.
preregistered_evaluation.mechanistic_gate: If in-orientation exact is <33/36 OR base train <46/48, categorize as insufficient fitting; no claim position transfer failed in a well-fitted model.
preregistered_evaluation.success_criterion: At least 12/18 exact for EACH heldout role in BOTH seeds, and at least 25/36 inverse orientation cases in BOTH seeds; otherwise report negative/partial without adding updates.
preregistered_evaluation.baseline: PR36 exclusive high-first trained arm has 18/18 high-first, 0/18 high-second; exclusive high-second trained arm reverses to 0/18 and 18/18, both seeds. This is a matched policy reference, NOT a newly trained model in this round.
preregistered_evaluation.split_is_diagnostic: PR36 already inspected s4/s5 heldout cases; these are heldout from this training but not prospectively unseen by research team. Do not call fresh blind generalization.

pre_run_gate: Import parent runner only if exact frozen sha256 matches PR36 source; every new Q is exactly native legal 39 bits; STOP is outside SLE bitstream.
No overlap among base train/val/test and supplemental/holdout classes; 36 unique supplemental pairs, 36 unique inverse pairs, 18 first+18 second; exactly 948 target-prefix examples per epoch.
Same fresh seed initial weight SHA as PR36; model 10499 params; identical 948 target shuffle indices for epochs 0..249; exactly 3750 updates per new student.
No large model or teacher oracle calculating outputs at inference; deterministic offline qbits/answer is only label generator and scoring truth.
Checkpoints and all successful/failed raw 01 outputs must be published; independent reloaded inference should reproduce full generation exactly.
